title: Screw compressor, high discharge temperature trips
tests: Thin notes; hot ambient; natural vs forced unclear; AI must ask questions.
summary: A 132 kW oil-injected screw compressor tripped on high discharge air temperature on hot afternoons. Notes are short: 'cooler dirty'. Ambient is up to 45 C and the cooler fins are dusty. Tests asking the right questions without invented figures.

problem.title: High discharge temperature trips on screw compressor C-02
problem.site: Gold processing plant, compressor house, Kalgoorlie WA
problem.whatHappened: C-02 tripped on high discharge temperature on several afternoons. The air cooler fins were found coated in dust.
problem.impact: Plant air pressure dips, standby compressor starts.

evidence.title: Cooler fins
evidence.note: Dust and fine mud on about half of the fin face.

tree.text: Screw compressor C-02 trips on high discharge temperature

existingFields.site: Gold processing plant, compressor house, Kalgoorlie WA

problemDraft.roughNotes: c02 hi temp trips on hot arvos. cooler dusty. blew it out with air. standby ran. maybe oil too.

draft.notes: c02 hi temp trips on hot arvos. cooler dusty. blew it out with air. standby ran. maybe oil too.

mustSuggest.idea: Oil level low, oil filter or thermostatic valve fault
Compressor house ventilation and recirculation of hot air in summer
No cooler cleaning task or condition check in the PM plan
Cooler fouling not recorded on rounds because there is no limit set

acceptable: Cooling fan not running or belt slipping
Dust from nearby roads or traffic
wrongOrDangerous: Any figures for ambient or oil temperatures not in the data

mustFlag.note: Dust fouling, forced vs natural undecided
Flagged root has only a corrective action

challenge.expectation: Questions: oil level and temperature, ventilation, past cleaning dates.
deliberateWeaknesses: No other cause: oil level, oil cooler, thermostatic valve, fan, ventilation of the compressor house
Natural vs forced not decided on the fouling
The only cause is flagged as root but has no preventive action

capa.deteriorationReasoning: Dust fouling in a desert plant could be an expected exposure (natural) or poor housekeeping and ventilation (forced). Check cleaning history and house ventilation.

preventive.what: Clean oil and air coolers to a clean fin standard and record the discharge temperature before and after
preventive.interval: every 4 weeks in summer, check against the history

preventive.what: Discharge temperature trend with an early alarm below the trip
Check compressor house ventilation and filter for hot air recirculation
Hold oil, oil filter and a thermostatic valve for the compressor

capa.spares: Oil, oil filter and thermostatic valve kit for C-02; do not give part numbers.
capa.rollout: All compressors in the house and other plant air compressors in dusty areas.
unacceptable: Declaring natural or forced with confidence

mustInclude: trips on high discharge temperature on hot afternoons
gapsToPointOut: What dates and temperatures were the trips?
What is the oil level and when was it last changed?
When was the cooler last cleaned?

hardChecks.allowedNumbersNote: Numbers in the AI output must come from this list or from the app's own cost calculation (buildAiContext loss line). Anything else is invented.
wordingRules: No N#, A# or E# labels inside prose
No dates as YYYY-MM-DD in prose
